name: Upload a File
description: Uploads a small file to Box. [See the documentation](https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content/).

configurable_props.name: file
configurable_props.label: File Path or URL
configurable_props.description: The file to upload. Provide either a file URL or a path to a file in the `/tmp` directory (for example, `/tmp/myFile.txt`)

configurable_props.name: createdAt
configurable_props.label: Created At
configurable_props.description: Defines the time the file was originally created at. If not set, file's original upload time will be used. Must be in RFC3339 format without milliseconds, e.g. `2022-07-20T10:53:43-08:00`

configurable_props.name: modifiedAt
configurable_props.label: Modified At
configurable_props.description: Defines the time the file was last modified at. If not set, file's original modified time will be used. Must be in RFC3339 format without milliseconds, e.g. `2022-07-20T10:53:43-08:00`

configurable_props.name: fileName
configurable_props.label: File Name
configurable_props.description: The name of the file. If not set, file's original name will be used.

configurable_props.name: parentId
configurable_props.label: Parent
configurable_props.description: The parent folder to upload the file to. If not set, `0` will be used as root folder.
